The project is a tiny static site at the repository root: `index.html` is the whole site, with inline styles, `favicon.ico` and `favicon.svg`. There is no build step, no dependencies, no tests. Do not add any. Do not touch files outside your task's `Files:` line; in particular leave `README.md`, `test.md`, `.the-framework/`, `.agents/`, `.claude/` and `.openagent/` alone. Every new page must match the style of `index.html`. Copy its `` exactly (charset, viewport, the comment about relative favicon links, both `` tags with relative hrefs `favicon.ico` and `favicon.svg`), changing only ``. Keep its CSS as-is (dark `#0f172a` background, the same font stack, body centered with flex, `h1` in `#f8fafc` at 3rem weight 600), and add only what a page with more than a heading needs: - `flex-direction: column;` on `html, body` so items stack. - body text (`p`, `li`) in `#cbd5e1`, `font-size: 1.125rem`, `line-height: 1.6`, `max-width: 40rem`, and `padding: 0 1.5rem` on the content so it doesn't touch the edges. - links (`a`) in `#f8fafc` with an underline. All links are relative (`index.html`, `about.html`, `files.html`), never root-absolute: the site is served from the `/test-project/` subpath. Use two-space indentation in CSS, as `index.html` does. `, one short `

` saying what this repo is, and a last `

` with a link `Back to home`. It should say: this is a single static page; no build step, no dependencies; it shows one centered greeting, "Hello, and welcome.", on a dark background; it is deployed with GitHub Pages. Two to four sentences, no more. The files this task changes: about.html Check your work with: grep -q 'About' about.html && grep -q '
